answer: Twelve strangers must agree before the name goes on the roll. Brewer licence with food safety authority attestation is their verdict: two-year training, 200 supervised brews, hygiene exam, licence renewed yearly. The mesa is the jury — people with no stake in the outcome, paid by the court, keeping their own notes. Bribing one juror buys one vote; a hundred fake names need a hundred juries, and the terrace is the first jury's price: twelve careers, twelve pensions, twelve reputations, all wagered on a stranger. The voyage is the court record, which anyone may read.
